$comment: The country opening pack's source registry (wave 7 PR4). Reviewed in pull requests like the reference sets. Every source carries its licence and attribution line and the domains the fetch may touch; a {year} in a url is a series resolved to the current edition at build time. Builders J and K fill the generic set and the per-country entries from docs/vault-hub/wave7/04-step-changes.md P1 and 00-practice-scan-research.md; this skeleton fixes the shape (vault/src/country/types.ts CountryRegistry).

GB.name: United Kingdom
GB.accounts_note: NSTA Open Data needs no account and no key (no stated rate limit; many datasets update daily). The UK National Data Repository (ndr.nstauthority.co.uk) is a separate portal with its own API (OGC WMS, GeoService, GeoJSON; an NDR API through Microsoft Graph for project and file metadata) and is not open data: registration with the NDR is required, and licensees report to it under the data regulations. Costs: not published; ask.
